results.text: Efficacy and safety of bisoprolol fumarate compared with carvedilol in Japanese patients with chronic heart failure: results of the randomized, controlled, double-blind, Multistep Administration of bisoprolol IN Chronic Heart Failure II (MAIN-CHF II) study. Bisoprolol fumarate (bisoprolol) is a β-blocker widely used to treat chronic heart failure (CHF).
